title: Electronic receipt.
bodyText:
Following the completion of a prearranged ride, the transportation network company shall transmit an electronic receipt on behalf of the transportation network company driver that includes the following information:

(1) The origin and destination or destinations of the prearranged ride;

(2) The total time and distance of the prearranged ride; and

(3) The total fare paid.
bodyHtml:
[§279J-7]  Electronic receipt.  Following the completion of a prearranged ride, the transportation network company shall transmit an electronic receipt on behalf of the transportation network company driver that includes the following information:

     (1)  The origin and destination or destinations of the prearranged ride;

     (2)  The total time and distance of the prearranged ride; and

     (3)  The total fare paid. [L 2022, c 57, pt of §2]
